note: Source of truth for the program. The app reads this on launch. Edit here or in the app.

exercises.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Shin vertical at the top, pelvis tucked, ribs down. Left leg first. Mark your foot position.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cue: Torso leaned 30-45 degrees forward. Left first.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Hamstring-dominant by design - don't chase glute feel here.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Torso leaned forward. Stop at 15, then add load.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Kickback
exercises.cue: Torso near parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Back to 50 kg - your October number. Feet mid-platform, no lumbar rounding at the bottom.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: LEFT SIDE ONLY. Bodyweight, no dumbbell. Stop 1-2 reps short.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Press
exercises.cue: Forefoot on the plate edge, knees soft, full heel sink, 2s pause. 45 kg.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Bodyweight. Add reps 6 to 8 to 10 to 12 before any load. Shin vertical, pelvis tucked.

exercises.name: Kickstand RDL
exercises.cue: Back toe down for balance only, ~90% of the load through the front leg.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.cue: Same machine as Monday - higher reps here.
